known_preexisting_residuals.finding: WireStream still returns after first event-producing frame and awaits a new chunk before draining remaining complete lines; EOF can synthesize success from content/tools without terminal evidence. Fixture helpers do not cover production chunk partitions.
known_preexisting_residuals.classification: Existing working-tree hardening residual, not introduced by forward integration.

known_preexisting_residuals.finding: Refresh requires env client ID even for Copilot empty-ID flow, ignores config-only login ID, fallback caches credential path without same refresh preparation, and persistence can reject a proactively rotated pair based on old-token liveness alone.
known_preexisting_residuals.classification: Existing working-tree defect already recorded in ledger; not fixed by bringing companion code into Git.

known_preexisting_residuals.finding: Reference-constructor diffs do not repair admission/acknowledgment races.
known_preexisting_residuals.classification: Existing frontend residual; no claim of concurrency correctness.

known_preexisting_residuals.finding: Trust keys are lexically normalized, not filesystem-resolved. Whole-app command/UI parity and other ledger findings remain open.
known_preexisting_residuals.classification: Known identity/product limitations, separate from source closure.

additional_static_findings.finding: write_auth_file creates/writes predictable auth.tmp before chmod(0600); comment says secret is never visible at default permissions, but creation is not owner-only. Fixed temporary pathname and stale-lock discipline also need hardening. Final-mode test cannot establish secure creation.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Existing WT code, not a new integration edit. Prevents clean-security approval; do not exploit/reproduce. Parent records follow-up separately.

additional_static_findings.finding: bedrock_event_payloads has no production caller; selected transports always construct SSE WireStream although adapter states native Bedrock uses binary event-stream. Helper comments claim CRC validation but implementation only slices framing.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Source closure does not make Bedrock a verified working protocol.

additional_static_findings.finding: bearer_token/adc_jwt_input are helper/test surfaces with no production ADC exchange caller; headers send supplied key verbatim. ADC placeholder login path is not completed by adding this module.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Do not advertise ADC as working; baseline integration is not implementation completion.

additional_static_findings.finding: Decoder creates call_id|item_id. Replay sends whole paired ID as function_call.call_id but strips result call_id before |, causing inconsistent pairing on the next tool-result request. Existing one-response fixture does not cover replay.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Provider correctness residual, not compile blocker; needs offline replay regression in later authorized hardening.

additional_static_findings.finding: Command helper .output() has no timeout/output bound despite module claim of 10 seconds. Catalog explicitly skips command-valued keys, so this is not proof of hot-path command execution.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Do not claim timeout guarantees. Source-only finding, no command reproduction.

additional_static_findings.finding: After a live empty-output failure, retry buffers a fresh first Done(Error) and next() returns that first event without reapplying retry classification; remaining budget is bypassed for mixed live/pre-stream failures.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Newly noticed existing-WT retry edge, not introduced by committing source closure.

additional_static_findings.finding: No-model branch checks credentialed_providers before it is populated; intended credentials-exist/no-model blocker cannot fire there.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Doctor diagnostic logic residual; source resolution unaffected.

additional_static_findings.finding: Unreadable/corrupt trust data becomes empty on write, dropping prior denials. TUI test explicitly codifies healing a corrupt store. Read failure falls back to no remembered decision, not preservation of a denial.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Existing baseline policy/data-preservation risk; no security-clean verdict.

additional_static_findings.finding: Accepted callback stream does not explicitly set nonblocking/read timeout; loop checks read deadline only after WouldBlock/TimedOut. Cross-platform bounded-read behavior is not established by the Windows-inheritance comment.
additional_static_findings.integration_effect: Needs defensive cross-platform validation later, not an exploit reproduction.

additional_static_findings.finding: sigv4_signing_matches_aws_reference_vector checks scope/hex length/determinism, not a pinned expected signature. Test name/comment overstates reference-vector evidence.
